title: The Unquiet Portrait
author: Coral Coldharbour
blurb: Tamsin Voss, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
